rationale: X surfaces more of the ground truth's substantive open concerns, notably the reviewer-flagged [High] v2-tokenizer-misdetection bug (hsliuustc0106) as a top-billed major finding, plus the WER-fallback bogus-data issue and partial docstring-staleness coverage, giving it stronger recall despite some speculative claims (e.g. Realtime yaml slot mismatch, legacy-codec streaming API) that aren't verifiable from the shown diff and cost it some precision. Y is tighter and more rigorously self-validated — it correctly identifies the abort slot-leak as already fixed on GPU and pinpoints a precise residual NPU gap, and catches a diff-verifiable finding (the qwen3_tts gate removal on tts_local_seed) — earning higher precision, but it buries the High-severity tokenizer bug as a minor 'additional observation' and misses several other line-level concerns, softening its recall. Both are highly actionable with concrete file/line evidence and proposed fixes.
